watches.name: Siebe Gorman Type D Professional Diver - Patina Brass Edition Pre-order for 30/11/26
watches.description: Open to our VIP subscribers for pre-order and delivery at the end of November 2026. A British Legend Returns For over two centuries, the name Siebe Gorman has been synonymous with innovation beneath the surface. From pioneering diving equipment that changed underwater exploration forever, to supplying generations of professional divers, naval personnel and engineers, the name has earned a unique place in British maritime history. The new Siebe Gorman Type D has been created to honour that legacy. This is not a reissue or a tribute piece. It is an entirely new professional dive watch, designed with 20 years of industry experience from the ground up with over two years of research, engineering and development. Every component has been carefully considered to produce a modern tool watch that respects its heritage while meeting the expectations of today’s professional and enthusiast alike. Designed and tested in the United Kingdom by Helicon Watches, the Type D combines contemporary engineering, proven mechanical reliability and understated British design into a watch built for adventure. Designed to Perform The Type D has been engineered with one simple objective: to create an uncompromising professional dive watch that is as comfortable on land as it is beneath the surface. Its slim 11.9mm profile is exceptional for a 300-metre professional diver equipped with an integrated helium escape valve, giving the watch remarkable wearability without compromising strength or capability. Inside beats the respected Miyota 9039 high-beat automatic movement, chosen for its proven reliability, serviceability and precision. Surrounding it is a custom-designed anti-magnetic movement holder, helping protect the movement during everyday use. From the two-layer enamel dial and ceramic bezel to the generous application of Swiss Super-LumiNova®, every detail has been developed with clarity, durability and functionality in mind. Built to Last The Type D is manufactured from premium materials throughout. The 316L marine-grade stainless steel case is paired with a sapphire crystal featuring an internal anti-reflective coating, while the custom-designed stainless steel bracelet incorporates quick-release spring bars and an on-the-fly micro-adjustment clasp for effortless comfort. Limited Means Limited Like every Helicon project, the Siebe Gorman Type D is produced as a genuine limited release. Once an edition has sold out, it will not be repeated. Each watch carries its own individually numbered case back, ensuring every owner becomes part of a small production run created for collectors who value authenticity, exclusivity and thoughtful engineering rather than mass production. British Craftsmanship Beyond the Watch The attention to detail extends well beyond the watch itself. Every collector’s presentation package has been specially commissioned and is manufactured entirely in the United Kingdom, supporting British craftsmanship and specialist suppliers while creating an ownership experience worthy of the Siebe Gorman name. From the moment the box is opened, every detail reflects the same philosophy that guided the development of the watch itself: quality, authenticity and longevity. When we say limited, we mean it—there will be no further runs, no reissues, and no second chances. These four pieces represent the final chapter of the Master 62. A considered release In recognition of their role as display pieces, we have made a small adjustment to the original price. However, these remain part of the original limited production—not a reissue, not clearance stock, but true archive pieces. For collectors, this is something altogether different: * A sold-out reference * A complete set of final colourways * And a story that will never be repeated Condition Unworn | Photography & display sample Carefully handled | Presented in excellent condition Availability One per colour – once sold, the Master 62 collection is complete

watches.name: Helicon Master – Iridium Orange Gatherall Edition
watches.description: To celebrate being chosen by renowned Bond aficionado David Zaritsky ( The Bond Experience ) as his companion for this year’s 60th anniversary Thunderball Gatherall at GoldenEye, Jamaica , we’re proud to introduce a very special edition of our Iridium Master . GoldenEye, of course, was the legendary home of Ian Fleming , where Bond was born on the page, and Thunderball remains one of the most visually striking adventures of the 007 series. Its iconic orange and blue colour palette inspired this unique package – a nod to Bond’s enduring style and underwater daring. This special edition set includes: • The Helicon Master in Iridium Orange – a vintage-inspired diver’s watch with modern Swiss performance. • A finely engineered stainless-steel bracelet for everyday wear. • A vintage-style FKM rubber skin diver strap in deep Bond blue , echoing the tones of Thunderball ’s Caribbean waters. With just 50 Iridium Masters ever produced , this model is already a rare collector’s piece. And now, with its Bond connection, it becomes even more desirable. As of the Gatherall, over 60% are already sold out – meaning fewer than 20 remain available worldwide. This is your chance to own a dive watch that fuses heritage, exclusivity, and performance – a true secret agent’s companion. 👉 Secure your Thunderball Edition Iridium Master today, before it disappears beneath the waves. Inspired by a 1962 prototype Diver’s Watch found in the archives of a long-lost Swiss Watchmaker. The Helicon 62 Master is a classic design, retaining all the loved period elements of vintage watches, comfortable easy to wear, compact size, crisp legibility, eye-catching 1960’s colours and effortless style. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder and we spent months working with our dial maker to create just 50 unique individual and inspiring hand-assembled dials. Great care is taken to provide excellent clarity and superb legibility with our custom-designed high polish art deco indices and painted Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova Indices. Utilising the latest developments in watch manufacturing techniques, technology and premium materials such as sapphire crystals, scratch-resistant ceramic, Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova 316L Marine Grade Stainless Steel. From Office to the Ocean, Suit to Sweatshirt….The Helicon 62 Master is Style and Substance. Uplifting and inspiring, our unique orange Iridium dial has been created with a number of complex and classic watch manufacturing techniques. The base dial is given a very fine sun-ray finish using a metallic filament brush. The dial is then hand spun to give a subtle but effective fumé or smoked finish, with a lighter centre graduating to a darker edge. Think ‘tiger eye’ and you’ve got it. It’s a multi-dimensional dial that plays with light and comes alive with every movement of your wrist. watches.name: Helicon Professional Chronograph - Graphene Grey
watches.description: A Watch with a Mission Inspired by the rugged, highly collectible Seiko chronographs issued to the Royal Air Force in the 1980s, the Helicon Professional Chronograph is built to our exacting standards. Every detail of the watch has been carefully considered, with specifications designed for both precision and durability. 🚀 A Space-Age Chronograph from Britain? Can you imagine a British-built space shuttle? In the 1960s, the UK quietly developed one — at least on paper. It was called Project MUSTARD: the Multi-Unit Space Transport and Recovery Device. A bold, modular shuttle system that could launch into orbit and land like a plane. Years ahead of its time. Never built. But never forgotten. Inspired by the future that never was .... Here at Helicon Watches, we’ve always been fascinated by engineering stories lost to time — and the optimism behind them. This release is inspired by one of Britain’s boldest “what if” moments — and it’s been a long time in the making. It’s a tribute to British innovation, designed and assembled right here in the UK, and built to perform in all environments — even the most extreme. Key Features 316L stainless steel case – Built for toughness and longevity Sapphire crystal with internal AR coating – Superior scratch resistance and legibility Bi-directional bezel – Functional and easy to use in all conditions Two-layer dial – Adding depth and clarity to the design Swiss Super-LumiNova – Ensuring visibility in all lighting conditions Seiko Hybrid Quartz-Mechanical Movement – A proven, reliable engine for this timepiece Hydraulic case back – Designed for both negative and positive pressure resistance 100m water resistance – Built for adventure We have personally overseen the concepting, prototyping, design and assembly here in the UK - each intricate detail carefully considered, with absolutely nothing overlooked. The packaging was designed by Danielle and is bespoke - sourced and produced entirely here in the United Kingdom, working with five different British businesses. Each box is individually cut, folded and assembled by hand. Dimensions Diameter 41mm Thickness 11.95 mm Lug to lug length 47.5mm Lug width for straps 20mm Also available with an additional bracelet or nylon strap. Download the watch manual here .
